concerns_addressed: Out-of-scope files in diff range excluded per edge-case rule (apps/web/e2e/siklus-pemesanan.spec.ts, apps/web/order-flow.test.js, scripts/purge-e2e-artifacts.sh); verdict judges only in-scope files useOutletReorder.ts, useOutletReorder.test.ts, and api.ts cache extension.

Hook reuses topFavorites transitively via loadOutletCachedSections (apps/web/src/app/dashboard/api.ts calls topFavorites); no duplicated favorite-aggregation logic in hook, so red-flag 'Not reusing topFavorites' not triggered.
Audited committed content at pinned done_sha cfea1d9 (worktree contains an uncommitted refreshKey addition in useOutletReorder.ts; not part of this audit).

issues.description: Unused variable 'cart' destructured from options but never read; only setCart is used.
Unused import 'act' in test file; only renderHook and waitFor are used.

On cache-hit path availableCredit stays null (loadOutletCachedSections returns shopping/favorites/orders only, no credit), so credit_exceeded is always false until a cache miss triggers fetchOutletDashboard. R4 formula itself is correct when credit is present and server remains authoritative per spec; noting as soft-guard coverage limitation, not blocking.

strengths: Correct R1 composition: favorites-first then deduped unique items from last 3 orders (RECENT_ORDER_LIMIT slice + seen Set), inactive/missing-catalog items excluded (useOutletReorder.ts:110,144-200); verified by R1 test expecting [1,2,3,4,5,6,7] with H excluded.

Correct R5 enrichment: current_price/stock_quantity/is_active/display_name all sourced from products param, historical unit_price ignored; last_qty/last_purchased_at sourced from history meta (useOutletReorder.ts:132-200); verified by R5 test.

Correct R6 cache-miss behavior: loadOutletCachedSections preferred, fetchOutletDashboard awaited exactly once only when sections is null, then cache re-read (useOutletReorder.ts:94-105); verified by R6 test asserting fetch x1 and load x2.

Correct R4 credit formula: (current catalog price x last_qty) > available_credit with null/NaN guards, credit read from dashboard credit.available_credit (useOutletReorder.ts:100-102,188-191); verified by R4 test (30k x 2 > 50k).

No red flags: hook never calls /products or loadOrderFormProducts (imports only fetchOutletDashboard/loadOutletCachedSections); no new API endpoints; no direct outletOrdersCache mutation (state copies + slice); no hardcoded product data.

Good hygiene: loading/error states handled with cancelled-flag cleanup on token change/unmount; computations memoized via useMemo; addToCart additive via setCart and reorderLastOrder skips invalid items with reasons; file ~259 lines, no 3x duplication.
